descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Your mission starts at home and ends with a splash.

THE STATION
Your capsule docks itself while you watch. Unbuckle, push off and float through the modules of the space station, hand over hand along the rails. Meet the crew, open the Cupola shutters, photograph real places on the Earth below, water the lettuce, fix the life support and catch a floating ball of water.

THE RIDE HOME
Strap back in, undock and fire the deorbit burn. The windows glow orange as the plasma builds, then four parachutes bloom over the ocean and you splash down. The hatch swings open and the recovery team welcomes you back.

YOUR HOUSE
A cozy beach house at sunset with soft jazz playing. Your Cupola photos hang on the wall and loop on the TV, your mission patches fill the board, a telescope shows the Moon and a putting green runs to the window.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Launch from the pad, go straight to the station from the menu, or drift above the Earth in free orbit. Mission control talks you through every step and there is no way to fail.
